title: Bank of America Earns 29 Brandon Hall Group Human Capital Management Excellence Awards
summary: Bank of America announced it has been recognized with 29 Brandon Hall Group Human Capital Management Excellence Awards, including 20 Gold awards and nine Silver awards, for programs that support employee development, leadership, onboarding, benefits, workforce innovation and business performance.
body_markdown:
September 14, 2026 at 8:00 AM Eastern


#


Bank of America Earns 29 Brandon Hall Group Human Capital Management Excellence Awards


##


Recognition Highlights Innovative Employee Development, Talent, Benefits and Workforce Programs


## Key points


- Bank of America received 29 Brandon Hall Group Human Capital Management Excellence Awards in 2026.
- The recognition represents an increase from 26 awards received in 2025 and brings the company's total Brandon Hall Group awards to 253 over the past 16 years.
- The awards recognize achievements across several areas of the company, including The Academy, Global Talent, Talent Acquisition, Compensation & Benefits and Global Business Services. ****


## Key points


CHARLOTTE, N.C.


North Carolina


– Bank of America announced it has been recognized with 29[Brandon Hall Group Human Capital Management Excellence Awards](https://brandonhall.com/brandon-hall-group-announces-winners-of-the-2026-hcm-excellence-awards/) , including 20 Gold awards and nine Silver awards, for programs that support employee development, leadership, onboarding, benefits, workforce innovation and business performance.


The recognition represents an increase from 26 awards received in 2025 and brings the company's total Brandon Hall Group awards to 253 over the past 16 years.


*"The success of our employees is central to how we deliver for our clients and communities,"* said **Bernard Hampton, Head of The Academy at Bank of America** . *"These awards reflect the dedication of teammates across our company who continue to innovate, develop talent and create opportunities that help our employees grow and succeed."*


## The Academy recognized with 22 awards


The Academy, Bank of America's award-winning, employee onboarding, education and professional development organization, received 22 awards recognizing programs focused on leadership development, onboarding, learning innovation, employee engagement and career growth.

The company provides unmatched convenience in the United States, serving more than 69 million clients with approximately 3,500 retail financial centers, approximately 15,000 A T Ms
